findings.title: tag/untag bump updatedAt even when nothing changes
findings.why: Tagging with an existing tag, or untagging a tag the task doesn't have, returns an identical task apart from a new updatedAt. The list reports a change that did not happen. Task 002 doesn't say whether a no-op counts as a change, so this is only a nit.

findings.title: Plan documents contain only the placeholder scaffold
findings.why: The plans sw-life-cycle-1-2, 1-3 and 1-4 still hold the generated comment and no plan body. Their task documents are already approved, so the plans describe nothing.
